title: Miami-Dade police outraged by proposals to turn parts of Miami into GTA 6, saying that Rockstar's game embodies what they "work every single day to prevent"
description: The mayor of Miami-Dade, Florida has been pitching Rockstar Games about transforming parts of the county into recreations of areas from Grand Theft Auto 6, in the face of complaints from law enforcement and members of the judiciary. GTA 6 is itself inspired by Miami, so yes, this is one of those "simulation colonising reality" situations. The proposed publicity event would include "an immersive arrival experience" at Miami International Airport. with signs for Vice City and planes coated in GTA 6 livery, together with branded Metromover skytrains and specially designed manhole covers. It's a predictable bid to snaffle a few of those GTA marketing dollars, while driving up the regional circulation of affluent Vice City nuts. Also predictable: a few people, and specifically the cops, find the idea of their neighbourhood being mocked up to resemble a Grand Theft Auto game problematic. Miami-Dade sheriff Rosie Cordero-Stutz and commissioner Juan Carlos Bermudez have already spoken out against the potential deal, observing in a joint statement that "we should be promoting the Miami-Dade we have worked so hard to build, not a fictional version of our community defined by crime and violence.” Read more

title: GTA 6 Is Completely Changing How You Steal Cars
description: Carjacking in Grand Theft Auto games has been, as the title denotes, a staple of the series. Up until now, it's largely been the same. While there have been more details and animations added over the years, the premise has remained that you'll walk up to a car, press Y or Triangle, throw the driver out, get in and drive away. If the car was parked, you'd execute the same button press to smash the window and steal it. With GTA 6, carjacking is getting a complete overhaul. Here, we've got all of the information we know so far on how to steal cars in GTA 6. There are two ways to steal a car: taking one that's stationary, or taking one that someone's driving around in. However, there are more details that make GTA 6 feel more like true simulation gameplay now. How to steal a parked car As we saw in the GTA 6 extended look gameplay, when Jason approached a car, he had multiple options to choose from. The first option is a slim jim--a classic tool used to break into older vehicles. It slides down the window frame to adjust the lock, and in GTA 6, it seems like this is done via a lockpicking minigame. However, based on what we've heard so far, that won't work for every car. Depending on the year and model of the vehicle, you might not be able to use a slim jim. However, newer and more expensive cars might not work with this method. On top of that, there are trackers, meaning that the police can track your location when you steal a car. This changes the whole carjacking aspect of Grand Theft Auto. Normally, if you'd steal a car, you might catch some heat; maybe a nearby police officer sees you and follows you, but it's pretty easy to get away cleanly. This time, that isn't the case. If you do want to get away cleanly, you need an item to disable the tracking device. It seems like that item, along with the slim jim, is not something you start out with, meaning you'll need to progress through the story or complete side objectives to obtain them. Another interesting thing…

title: I’m Begging You To Stop Obsessing Over Player Numbers And Just Enjoy Games
description: Horror fans are confused. Every time a licensed multiplayer horror game gets brought up, two things tend to happen: commenters wonder if it can dethrone Dead by Daylight, and they speculate that the game will shut down quickly. It's happening again today, as I've recently published my Halloween review. Comments on YouTube and in Discord servers are already repeating the sentiments I've seen for many years now. "Probably be dead in six months to a year because no one can live aside DBD." "It will be dead within a month like the rest." "The real question is, will it go the way of Evil Dead, Friday the 13th, and Texas Chain Saw, and not touch Dead by Daylight?" I view this response as a kind of mass hallucination. This obsession over a game's health and future prospects is a widespread problem in a number of genres right now, but it's been especially irksome in the multiplayer horror space, where people rely on points that may feel true but don't prove accurate upon closer inspection. I've played nearly every licensed multiplayer horror game, like those named above and others, like Killer Klowns and Predator: Hunting Grounds. For the past decade, Hollywood licensors have been increasingly interested in adapting their intellectual properties to games, and with each new one revealed, there's an expectation among players and onlookers that they will die off, failing to topple the titan of the genre, Dead by Daylight. It's true that Dead by Daylight remains in a league of its own in terms of its community size. What I find absurd, though, is that these other games are seeking to usurp Behaviour Interactive's decade-long success story. Not one of these games seems to have aspirations or expectations of replacing DBD. Ultimately, they're very different things, and these other adaptations are only looking to earn their place alongside DBD. Halloween is the latest multiplayer horror game to be held up to the unfair DBD standard. In some important ways, Dead by Daylight is…

title: Where To Find Lacra In The Blood Of Dawnwalker
description: Are you looking for Lacra in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This fiendish vrakhiri--a potentially romanceable character at that--has been stalking her prey all over Vale Sangora. If you know the right people to ask, you might just learn of her whereabouts. A Friend Like This - Where to find Lacra in Svartrau City The quest where you find Lacra in The Blood of Dawnwalker is called A Friend Like This. It’s not available right from the get-go. Instead, you have to put in a bit of effort by heading to Svartrau City. There, you’ll meet a benign vrakhiri named Vicho, who wants your help in solving a murder. You can learn about the details in our A Study in Crimson guide. After killing Doctor Simeon, Vicho will mention another vampire that’s roaming around the capital. A map showing the locations that you need to investigate. From the streets to the rooftops If you check the journal entry for A Friend Like This, you’ll see that there are three spots in the northern part of the city that you need to check. Walk along the streets near the city’s gates and activate Focus Mode. You’ll see glowing objects, such as blood spatters, destroyed barrels, and fallen tiles. Keep following your lead until you spot roof tiles that have been damaged. If it’s nighttime/you’re in vampire form, simply Shadowstep/Planeshift onto the roof. Traverse the buildings, all while using your Focus ability to search for more tiles. Eventually, you’ll reach a small house in a walled-off section of the city. Follow the clues (left) until you reach Lacra's hideout (right). Lacra boss fight Your first meeting with Lacra in The Blood of Dawnwalker is actually a boss battle. Once you step inside the building, you’ll have a short conversation with Lacra, before she turns hostile. Be careful when fighting her since she has quick strikes with her claws. She can also transform into a wolf, leaping at you for a deadly bite. Note: If you attempt to use Voracious Bite on Lacra, she’ll just elbow you in the face. You…

title: Where To Find The Hidden Uriash Village In The Blood Of Dawnwalker
description: Are you looking for the hidden Uriash Village in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This settlement is in a far-flung region that most humans can’t even reach. In fact, it will remain accessible to Coen unless you’re able to tackle some pre-requisite tasks. Song of the Mountain - The Hidden Uriash Village The hidden Uriash Village in The Blood of Dawnwalker, which is in the western corner of the map, can’t be visited under normal circumstances. If you attempt to climb up the mountainous area west of Rockfalls, a prompt will tell you that you’re not allowed to go any further, causing you to respawn some distance away. To gain access to it, you must first meet a vampiress named Lacra. You can learn about all the info in our A Friend Like This guide. After completing A Friend Like This, you’ll be able to speak with an uriash prisoner. Spare him and tell him that you’ll avoid killing the uriash in the village. This makes the Song of the Mountain quest appear in your journal. If you track it, you’ll see that your next task is to meet up with Lacra in Crown Rock. Since Lacra is a vrakhiri, you can only do this quest at night. Lacra wants you to go with her to the village. Traveling with Lacra Here’s what you need to know about The Blood of Dawnwalker Song of the Mountain quest: After talking to Lacra in Crown Rock, she’ll goad you into feeding on an unwary shepherd. Tell her that the experience is “an excellent one” to avoid offending her. Continue along the mountain pass. If you see vertical cliff faces, use your Shadowstep and Planeshift to traverse the area. At certain points, you have to fight wild animals, including wolves and bears. Drink the blood of the shepherd (left) and slay some beasts (right). The troublesome trolls Save your game when you’re almost at the summit. That’s because the uriashi matriarch and her cohorts will appear. They'll start pelting Coen with rocks, all while Lacra insists that you need to make them pay for their insolence. You’ll be presented with…

title: How To Help Ocha In The Blood Of Dawnwalker – The Heart Wants What It Wants Guide
description: Do you want to help Ocha in The Blood of Dawnwalker? The daughter of the uriash matriarch is somewhere in the capital, and she seems to have gotten into a bit of trouble. Our guide, which tackles A Mother’s Plea and The Heart Wants What It Wants, has all the info you need. She’s the last in line because her daughter, Ocha, is missing. Time to head to the capital. Where to find Ocha in Svartrau City Your only clue if you want to find Ocha in The Blood of Dawnwalker is that she’s in one of the taverns in Svartrau City. You can ask around, or you could head directly to the tavern in Altmarkt. Talk to the bartender, who’ll tell you that Ocha is sitting in the corner. When you chat with Ocha, she’ll get pissed off. You’ll be challenged to a fistfight. Win this bout…

title: There’s A Legendary Herb In The Blood Of Dawnwalker That Permanently Increases Your Health
description: Do you want to increase your character’s maximum health in The Blood of Dawnwalker? Survival is of the utmost importance, especially since you’ll be fighting against battalions of soldiers, hordes of undead, and cadres of vampiric hostiles. Thankfully, there’s a legendary herb that grants a one-time boon. In This Article The Hedgehog Herb and Razkovniche Plant guide The Hedgehog Herb - The dead alchemist and the ingredients Waiting for the Razkovniche Plant to grow How to craft the Razkovniche Elixir The Hedgehog Herb and Razkovniche Plant guide The item that permanently increases your maximum health in The Blood of Dawnwalker is known as the Razkovniche Elixir. It’s a reward from a quest that’s aptly called The Hedgehog Herb. To start the quest, head over to the southern part of the world map, all the way to an abandoned settlement called Oghasti. It’s close enough to one of the Scouting Towers, too. A map showing the location of Oghasti. The Hedgehog Herb - The dead alchemist and the ingredients Upon arriving at Oghasti, you’ll notice several houses in various states of disrepair. Inside one of the houses, there’s a corpse of a man. Activate Focus Mode and do the following: Pick up or interact with objects like the seedbox and Razkovniche Potion recipe. There’s also a Watering Can outside the hut. If it’s daytime, use your Astral Communion power to compel the spirit of the dead alchemist. Pick the Watering Can and the Razkovniche Potion Recipe so the spirit divulges more details. Grab several items (left) and show them to the lost soul (right). Waiting for the Razkovniche Plant to grow For the next part of The Blood of Dawnwalker Hedgehog Herb quest, simply inspect the ceramic pot on the bench. Then, plant the Razkovniche Seed and give it a few drops of your blood. This costs 1x Time Segment. You now have to wait for one full day to pass--i.e. if it’s currently noon (daytime at two pips), then you have to return the next noon. The plant will have grown by then,…

description: Are you looking for ways to save Mert in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This miller happens to be a cousin of one of Coen’s close friends. The Firebrand quest guide - How to save Mert with the help of a few bugs The Blood of Dawnwalker Firebrand quest becomes available quite early in the campaign: The next morning after the Blood Mass, you check on the burned village of Laslea Glen. As you approach a corpse of a guard, you’ll see a banner in front of a ruined house. The house once belonged to Coen’s friend, Vladimir, who has ties with the rebels. Enter it and activate Focus Mode to look for clues. You should find a sack with silver arrowheads and a burnt letter. Reading the letter kickstarts The Firebrand quest, which directs you to the home of a miller. Note: Ideally, you should complete The Firebrand quest during the day. Since Coen is a human, there should be more options to converse with other NPCs. In our playthrough, however, we tackled these objectives at night. We did encounter a few bugs, which were helpful instead of being a hindrance. You receive The Firebrand quest during the prologue. She’ll tell you about her cart, which is a way for her to inform…

title: Should You Spare Isbrand In The Blood Of Dawnwalker – Our Rotten Roots Guide
description: Are you thinking of whether you should abandon or spare Isbrand in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This ancient vampire lord has been around for centuries, though he’s been left in a weakened state. Maybe he can aid you in the battles ahead? Oh, and before we continue, please know that this guide contains spoilers. In This Article Our Rotten Roots quest guide - Should you spare or abandon Isbrand Anachora and the Isbrand boss fight Should you invite Isbrand in? Our Rotten Roots quest guide - Should you spare or abandon Isbrand The Blood of Dawnwalker Our Rotten Roots quest is actually part of a very long story arc involving the vampiress Lacra. For starters, you meet her during A Friend Like This. That’s followed by Song of the Mountain, where you travel with her to a hidden Uriashi Village. She’ll then ask you to help her find Isbrand during Hive and Seek. Your delve deep underground culminates in a massive battle against hordes of kobolds and their larger kin. Once all the hostiles have been eliminated, you can check one of the chests nearby to obtain Isbrand’s Plate, a legendary medium chestpiece that grants maximum vampiric health, claw critical hit chance, claw critical hit damage, and blood drinking restoration. Get ready to battle an entire horde. Anachora and the Isbrand boss fight Coen and Lacra then take Isbrand’s near-lifeless carcass to Westridge Outpost. After a day has passed, you can tackle the Our Rotten Roots quest. It involves diving into Isbrand’s memories, entering a realm called Anachora: In the third major area, you’ll see a fork in the road. Lacra does not want you to head to the left, as she wants to keep her past a secret. If you continue there, you’ll learn about the grievous harm that Isbrand caused. You can also apologize to Lacra later. At the end of the sequence, you have to fight Isbrand, with Lacra as your ally. Isbrand has erratic attack patterns, so try to block or dodge his blows if you can. He also casts Piercing Shriek at a wide…

title: How To Help Father Florin In The Blood Of Dawnwalker – Hero’s End Guide
description: Are you hoping to help Father Florin in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This wily priest hasn’t been around since the prologue. If you do manage to find him, then he has a proposal that might pique your interest. Of course, he also has his ulterior motives. title: All Sword Shard Locations In The Blood Of Dawnwalker – Forge It Anew Guide
description: Are you searching for all the Sword Shards in The Blood of Dawnwalker? These items are necessary if you want to complete the Forge It Anew quest. With these, you’ll be able to create one of the best weapons in the entire game. In This Article Forge It Anew - All Sword Shards in Vale Sangora Forge It Anew: Do Not Disturb Forge It Anew: Executive Order Forge It Anew: Hostile Takeover The Uriash Blacksmith The final trial for the Sword of St. Mihai Forge It Anew - All Sword Shards in Vale Sangora The Blood of Dawnwalker Forge It Anew quest isn’t available right from the get-go. You actually need to explore a bit just to make it appear in your journal: One method is to visit any of the three caves that we discuss in detail below. Each cave has a mural that depicts the landscape of the valley. Inspecting it reveals the other locations on the world map. The other option is tied to a different side quest called A Monk and a Saint. You obtain a broken weapon and you learn that shards are needed to reforge it. Note: Trying to obtain each shard requires 3x Time Segments. A map showing the locations of all three Sword Shards. Forge It Anew: Do Not Disturb The first Sword Shard in The Blood of Dawnwalker comes from the Do Not Disturb sub-quest. You have to go just a bit north of the Maragir Wealds marker on the world map. From the marked location, you’ll see a large and slanted rock formation. Pass underneath it and follow the path until you stumble upon a pack of kobolds. Kill them as you see fit, and enter the cavern to eliminate more hostile creatures. Once the coast is clear, pick up the shard from the nest. Head past the rock formation (left) and finish off the pack of kobolds (right). Forge It Anew: Executive Order There’s another kobold cave further southeast in the ridges near Tantari. However, once you get there, you’ll realize that Xanthe’s soldiers have killed all the creatures. Read the note to learn that the soldiers have taken their plunder to a camp due…

title: How To Repair St. Mihai’s Sword In The Blood Of Dawnwalker

title: Experiencing some day one Blood of Dawnwalker issues? Its devs know, and have some temporary solutions to help get you bloodsucking
description: It's The Blood of Dawnwalker release day! The debut game of Rebel Wolves and the first new game from director Konrad Tomaszkiewicz since The Witcher 3. A day of what should be celebrations for many, I'm sure, instead a day of "oh, huh, this isn't running so well on PC, is it?" This is fairly common for big releases these days, but the devs do come with some temporary suggestions for the variety of issues they're aware of. Read more

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword is best when it's silly, and despite some gloomy open world slogging, sometimes even remembers it
description: The opening minutes of Onimusha: Way of the Sword are glorious, in the sense that they’re utterly shambolic. Wandering ronin Musashi wakes up under a bridge, belts a wrong-footingly British "WOT?!" at some starving urchins eyeing up his rice ball, then proceeds to be chased around a muddy village by what feels like two thousand martial arts students, only occasionally stopping to boot a wooden plank into their faces or scoop up an imperilled dog. It’s goofy and brash and genuinely funny, in a way that immediately looks to elevate it among the field of po-faced fantasy slashers as effectively as any well-honed parry mechanic. Why in the following hours, then, does Way of the Sword make only occasional attempts to match this intro’s energy? Read more

title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation finally gets a 2027 release date, as Final Fantasy Resonance gets a surprise demo
description: We already knew that Final Fantasy 7 Revelation was going to launch sometime in 'spring 2027 ', but today director Naoki Hamaguchi took to Sony's State of Play livestream to inform us all that the game has a locked-in release date: 8th April, 2027. It'll launch worldwide, and on all platforms - that's PS5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X/S, and PC - at the same time (the first game in the series to do so). Read more

title: The first big Crimson Desert DLC arrives in October, seems to be set in a crimson desert beyond Crimson Desert's existing crimson desert
description: Crimson Desert 's first proper expansion, not be confused with any of the ten million things Pearl Abyss have added to their vast expanse of stuff to do via free updates, is set to release next month. It's called Charting the Unknown, is out on October 15th, and looks to be set into a new realm filled with more game mechanics you've seen elsewhere shoved together to fill a vast open world.
